subject.why: The space shuttle is instantly recognisable, featuring chunky stylized proportions, landing gear, cockpit window, delta wings, engines, and the requested red crescent moon on the tail fin.

category.why: The composition strictly follows Category 3 with the shuttle resting on a smooth glossy floor with soft reflections against a plain gradient wall.

clean.why: There are no UI elements, text, logos, watermarks, or characters.

framing.why: The shuttle is well-centred with generous, balanced margins on all sides.

colour.why: The warm sunny yellow wall and cream floor complement the crisp white and navy blue shuttle, providing vibrant contrast and clear separation.

detail.why: Shapes are clean and smooth without unnecessary surface clutter, panel lines, or micro-textures.

style.why: The smooth volumes, soft lighting, and clean satin finish perfectly match the style of the references.

bg_colour.why: background is yellow (100% of the background); planned yellow
